verdict.rationale: Requesty's own analytics dashboard tracks costs, requests, tokens, cache savings and latency in real time, so the metrics side of the story is documented. Nothing shows a per-request log where an engineer can open an individual request and response payload with those metrics attached; the evidence reads as aggregate usage analytics. Missing for 10: per-request log inspection, stored request/response bodies, per-request cost/token/latency attribution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can inspect logged requests and responses with latency, token counts, and cost attached

citations.quote: Track costs, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency, all in real-time.
